title: Fibonacci EA v5.0 Factory Baseline Characterization
research_question: What are the empirical baseline performance, trade frequency, and drawdown metrics of Fibonacci_EA_v5_0 on GBPUSD M15 across the training partition (2020.01.01 to 2024.12.31) under factory default parameters?
hypothesis: Executing Fibonacci_EA_v5_0 under factory default parameters on GBPUSD M15 across the 2020.01.01-2024.12.31 training partition will establish an authoritative empirical baseline with 100% history quality, zero prop firm guard violations (daily loss < 4.0%, total drawdown < 8.0%), and reveal the actual trade frequency under the default multi-filter conjunction stack.

facts: Fibonacci_EA_v5_0 was introduced into the ea/ repository as a prop-firm optimized Fibonacci retracement strategy.
The EA compiles via MetaEditor 64 with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
Default parameters specify BUY-only direction (InpDirection=0), fixed 15-pip SL (InpMaxSLPips=15.0), and active news filtering (InpUseNewsFilter=true).
inferences: Before any parameter adjustments or logic modifications can be evaluated, a controlled baseline experiment on the unmutated EA is scientifically required.
The conjunctive filter stack (H1 EMA trend + Session + News + Tiered RSI/MACD/Rejection) may produce low trade frequency on GBPUSD M15.
evidence: Fibonacci_EA_v5_0.mq5 source code inspection confirms active trading logic in OnTick() and trade execution in ExecTrade().

independent_variables.name: EA_Architecture
independent_variables.rationale: Transitioning from pipeline test stub to active Fibonacci retracement strategy requires establishing a new baseline reference.

assumptions: MT5 Strategy Tester has access to GBPUSD M15 historical bars for the 2020.01.01-2024.12.31 training partition.
Order filling mode ORDER_FILLING_IOC is supported by the tester execution environment.
expected_observations: History quality reaches 100% on GBPUSD M15.
Total trades > 0 executed by the active Fibonacci retracement logic.
Total equity drawdown maximal remains below the 8.0% prop firm circuit breaker limit.
falsification_conditions: History quality is below 99% or bars processed equals 0.
Strategy trips the 4.0% daily loss or 8.0% total drawdown guard.
Total trades equals 0 due to execution or order fill failure.
